open_work: Eight immutable source records keep their original identities, hidden poses, hero roles, plans and body/valve maxima. The source author explicitly calls for a set with its back off, a scope and a signal generator in this signal trade.

ADAPTATION: connected positive enclosure panels, open-back chassis stock, seated opal valves and passive knobs replace coarse boxes. The original plain-colour scope face retains its source mesh and material; a rim seats around its outside edges and projects 1mm ahead. No new lettering, signal, illumination, tuning authority or instrument operation is inferred.
ADAPTATION: valve sockets bridge the existing 10mm gap to the original chassis crown. Every original instrument bottom stays at the existing 1.01m worktop datum.
Local registered enamel_appliance and nickel_plated variants use the existing catalogue. Original unselected material owners and shared maps/shaders remain.

The accepted native bench is retained as conservative contact/context authority. Other shop stock, battery rack, speakers, counter, cabinet, services, carrier behavior and routes remain separate owners.

Native volumes, stock joins, exact source replacement, retained bench contacts/context, strict metric UVs and rendered review remain required. This ignored preparation grants no runtime proof or acceptance.

Slice 57 of the V2 environment dossier: the five bench valves become round shouldered envelopes in smoked glass (valve_opal tinted) with a silvered getter flash (registered mirror_aged), crowns and socket joints unchanged (CITY_SHOP_RADIO_SERVICE-003); the open-back set gets a wordless dial (nickel bezel, cream scale, raised ticks) with its pointer at the top of the band, and a cone speaker on its own foot beside it on the bench, corded to the set (-001). The open-channel hiss is not authored: the shop has no ambience owner.
